column1: # Proxy mappings: target OFF tagid -> source_baseIngredient
# When a baseIngredient has no direct tagid, but a related baseIngredient's ecobalyse
# data can be used as a proxy. All properties for proxy targets start with
# ecobalyse_proxy_ prefix (global properties also use proxy prefix).
# no visible generic poultry or rabbit entries in Ecobalyse: use chicken breast
# herbs without fresh / dried precision: consider it is dried
# (herb-dried is also auto-proxied by the matching script, kept here for reference)
# Generic/parent ingredients proxied from more specific matched baseIngredients
# flour is a proxy for en:flour, as it is in fact wheat flour in Ecobalyse
# Generic ingredients found in cooking recipes (scripts/recipes_coverage)
# white wine entries are not visible in Ecobalyse: use red wine
